metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Photorealistic winter landscape of a frozen lake with smooth, clear ice. Several people are ice skating, and visible white vapor clouds emanate from their mouths into the crisp cold air. Frost crystals coat a nearby wooden dock railing. Bright overcast sky, highly detailed, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: In freezing conditions, human breath condenses into visible vapor, and surfaces accumulate frost, matching the frozen lake.
